title: AMC 8 Practice: Mixture Problem — Pour It There, Pour It Back
description:
AMC 8 practice problem on mixtures and percent, solved by following the juice liter by liter between two jugs. (Level 4 of 5)
Pour juice into water, stir, then pour some back. How much of the drink is juice now?
Follow the juice liter by liter with Vantee, then try a new mix on your own.
An AMC 8-style arithmetic question, with two ways to solve it and the traps to avoid.
